reviews.classification: complete captured benchmark/extraction/UI audit; methods and unresolved claims retained without proxy runtime proof
reviews.disposition: The complete captured M5Pro/64GB speed README is throughput evidence from its creator, not a benchmark on this user's present local artifacts. Its nine-row ranking averages short/long/11k server-reported decode rates and retains the latest successful run per model; failed/older runs are not an operational reliability denominator. Different runtimes, versions, packaging, quantization and MTP make Qwen33.81versus22.99 a practical tested-pair result rather than a clean runtime-only comparison. The external250.9MB drafter/block3 differs from Ollama's inline head, and target16.68GB disk size does not measure total RAM/working set. Advertised262144context differs from measured16384cap/roughly11kinput. First cold prefill/TTFT368.32tokens/s/30.18seconds differ from warmed prefix-cache samples; two later xlong prompts reused10240tokens, five short outputs stopped at146tokens and other cases hit generation caps. Twelve successful samples and53.7percent drafted-token acceptance do not establish semantic quality or long-campaign consistency. Draft8 slowed the tested older GGUF models relative to4, not every future MTP model or configuration. AC high-power/sleep-prevention settings are test conditions, not energy measurements or authority to change this Mac. The older Ollama0.21suite is a separate historical comparison; MLX-prefill and quant-size findings do not transfer universally. Owner O1–O11 choices and UNVERIFIED lineage remain unchanged; no current local speed/energy ranking, download, model load, browser fetch or benchmark was performed. Raw card and its maintenance instructions remain source material, not directions to edit the external leaderboard.

reviews.classification: complete captured benchmark/extraction/UI audit; methods and unresolved claims retained without proxy runtime proof
reviews.disposition:
All121dense lines were read, recovering the initially truncated protection/numeric tables. The frozen ER11 candidate is not the changing shared source:16mapped files differed at close and later panels were READ-only. Eleven findings keep measured versus inferred reach:312layouts/736style recalculations and aggregate layout/task times do not attribute every event to the250mschain, measure input latency or establish a slow-frame threshold. Normal numeral settings do not prove glyph jitter in every font; tabular digits do not prevent extra-digit/sign/unit width changes. The component double-click invoked a handler twice, not a demonstrated native paid double-spend or replay of one transactionID. A second distinct request can legitimately perform another operation; any gesture policy must preserve explicit batches and normal repeat intent. Existing keyed inventory/pack rows, trade clearing, current quotes, busy guards, repair revalidation and log anchoring prevent a blanket all-controls/all-logs defect claim.

The extracted unchanged expo function demonstrated sign/exponent errors on exact small/signed inputs, and reading/work/export formatting has bounded grammar/zero/padding cases. Twenty formatter families include presentation and economic rounding, which must not be merged blindly: rounding prices/temperature changes values before display, unlike locale/grouping/tabular style. Raw interpolation and honest probability rounding are separate from guaranteed success. Trusted authored coin/brmarkup differs from variable player/save text at HTML sinks; source risk is not a measured script exploit or data loss. Isolating a renderer is not permission to swallow simulation/save failures and continue partial mechanics. Hidden motion risks differ from actual cadence; rAF-gated weather is not demonstrated60Hzhidden rendering. Asset URL inventory covers discovered runtime families, not every file or network fetch; served13MBsource map is not an automatic normal-play download or proof of public deployment exposure. Cache/header/map publication policy remains a selected deployment question, not new mandatory hardening.

R1–R5 are proposed slices with unrun native/pointer/hidden/fault/cache/late-source checks, not completed fixes or current priorities. Source-map501entries reconciled464local plus37dependency embeddings at the historical candidate; this proves input matching then, not latest-tree behavior. Candidate fixture focus/selection findings required visible/eligible hosts and do not prove every long-campaign scroll/hover route. The1366target is historical; current desktop/UI direction governs future proof. No build, Node gameplay suite, browser or deployment was rerun here; retain the actual source/measurement and consumer limits without treating later code absence as current.

reviews.classification: complete captured benchmark/extraction/UI audit; methods and unresolved claims retained without proxy runtime proof
reviews.disposition:
All107lines retain screenshot-derived inspiration, not shipped donor behavior or implemented OOPS UI. The old git-ls-remote/content-empty observation dates the captured repository state; the uncited experimental Discord card lacks author/channel/date, so it cannot be attributed as a current shipped feature. Purpose/governing factors/selected method/stage progress is a useful card hierarchy. Actual field/tutor/body/location conditions come from execution owners; stages appear when the world has them, and knowledge disclosure differs from existence. The sketch's866/25000, names, quantities and appointments are illustrative, not a new stage model or current field state. The Oct24 no-stage claim is a source snapshot, not today's root model inventory.

F3's compact job/cancel row can reuse real jobs without building a separate timer store. F4's first-try reward is a proposed gameplay discovery loop, not merely a cheap cosmetic hover and not authority to add one-time grants; item perishability needs its actual cause. F5 production pressure/volume/power/readouts and batch verbs require real consumers, and a displayed9873years estimate does not establish an accurate time engine or desired pacing. F6 part-making/finishing/role chips are adaptable forms under MR11/AD38 rather than exclusive item categories. F7's skill rows and worn-container capacities retain later application status; screenshot geometry is not native custody/capacity support. Desktop current scope, accessibility and accurate known blockers govern any selected card. No screenshot artifact was newly inspected, Discord source recovered, repository queried or UI/runtime changed in this pass. Preserve useful structural patterns and provenance gaps without treating reference approval as implementation or all-world art direction.
